terms.gloss: nod to someone; nod yes, give the nod
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 784: neque illa ūllī hominī nūtet, nictet, annuat
Liv. 1.12: adnuentibus ac vocantibus suīs ēvādit (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: nod, keep nodding; make a sign with the head
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 207: capite nūtat: nōn placet quod repperit

terms.gloss: refuse with a movement of the head; say no
evidence: Plaut. Capt. 481: ubi cēnāmus? inquam. atque illī abnuont

phrases.latin: neque illa ūllī hominī nūtet, nictet, annuat
phrases.english: and she is not to nod, wink, or beckon to any man

phrases.latin: eccere autem capite nūtat: nōn placet quod repperit
phrases.english: but look, he’s shaking his head: he doesn’t like what he’s come up with

sources: Lewis & Short: annuo · Lewis & Short: nuto · Lewis & Short: abnuo
